SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code
FROM omop.concept
WHERE (LOWER(concept_name) = 'pneumonia' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'pneumonia%')
  AND domain_id = 'Condition'
  AND standard_concept = 'S'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(concept_name) = 'pneumonia' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name
OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 20 ROWS ONLY;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH pneumonia_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 255848
  UNION
  SELECT 255848
), inpatient_visits AS (
  SELECT visit_occurrence_id
  FROM omop.visit_occurrence
  WHERE visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262) -- Inpatient Visit; Emergency Room and Inpatient Visit
    AND visit_start_date >= DATEADD(year, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
    AND visit_start_date < DATEADD(day, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_occurrence_id) AS inpatient_encounters_with_pneumonia_past_year
FROM inpatient_visits v
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
  ON co.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
JOIN pneumonia_concepts pc
  ON pc.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_occurrence_id) AS inpatient_encounters_with_pneumonia_past_year
FROM omop.visit_occurrence v
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
  ON co.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
WHERE v.visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262)
  AND v.visit_start_date >= CAST('2025-07-23' AS date)
  AND v.visit_start_date < CAST('2026-07-24' AS date)
  AND co.condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 255848
    UNION
    SELECT 255848
  );

823 inpatient encounters included a pneumonia diagnosis in the past year.

- inpatient visits: `visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262)`
- pneumonia: SNOMED concept `255848` plus descendants
